name: Eagle Industry Co Ltd
summary: Eagle Industry Co.,Ltd., operating with its global subsidiaries, focuses on the design, production, and sale of mechanical seals, specialty valves, and a wide array of other sealing products. The company's activities are organized into distinct segments serving the automotive and construction machinery, general industrial, semiconductor, marine, and aerospace sectors. Its extensive product range addresses diverse applications: in the automotive and heavy equipment sphere, it provides mechanical seals for water pumps, lip seals and control valves for air conditioning compressors, actuators and various valves for turbo systems, solenoid valves for automatic and continuously variable transmissions, and specific valves and metal pulsation dampers for fuel systems. Additionally, it offers accumulators for hydraulic circuits, reed valves for exhaust emission control, solenoid valves for air intake/exhaust systems, suspension accumulators, floating seals for undercarriages, and hydrogen control valves for fuel cell vehicles. For general industrial uses, the company supplies multi-spring seals, metal bellows seals, cartridge seals, dry seals for agitators, dry gas seals, and diaphragm couplings. Within the semiconductor industry, its products include magnetic fluid vacuum seals, rotary joints, and welded metal bellows. Marine applications benefit from oil and water-lubricated stern tube seals, oil-lubricated stern tube shaft bearings, and water-lubricated rubber bearings. Furthermore, for aerospace, it delivers seals for turbo pumps, main shafts, gearboxes, brushes, static components, and mechanical seals for aircraft, rockets, and spacecraft, including bellows accumulators for the International Space Station. In addition to its primary sealing business, the company is involved in the distribution of image processing products. Founded in 1964, Eagle Industry Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, and adopted its current name in June 1978, having previously operated as Nihon Sealol Co., Ltd.
